notes:
- **Archie for Business is now Archie for Teams.** Same app, same agents, same plan, and nothing to
  set up again; only the name changed. On Windows the update takes the old one's place, with your
  shortcuts and open at login carried over. On a Mac, System Settings may still list it as Archie
  for Business.
- **Archie for Teams catches up with Archie 0.3.5 and 0.3.6**, which it had been waiting on: the
  backup button on the plan screen, the search that waits after your agent reads new mail, and the
  rest of both releases.
- **On Archie for Teams, a new choice for the people you let in: Talk and add to your lists.** A
  teammate can add to or change the lists on your agent's Knowledge tab without being handed your
  mail, calendar or connected services.
- **On an Anthropic account, Economy now runs on Claude Haiku 5.5 and Balanced on Claude Sonnet
  5.5.** A model you picked yourself stays as it is. Model names now read the way people say them,
  Claude Sonnet 5.5 rather than claude-sonnet-5-5.
- **Checking off or editing a to-do in Todoist or Google Tasks happens at once**, with an undo that
  puts it back. Deleting one still waits for your yes.
- **When an AI company retires a model, your agent tries its replacement** instead of failing until
  the next update. Pictures made on OpenAI move to its newer picture model before the old one shuts
  down on October 23, and DeepSeek's Economy and Balanced move to the model that replaced its
  retired one.
- **Ask for a total from one of your lists and Archie adds it up itself**, rather than leaving the
  sum to the AI.
- **The add-on store opens on tiles, one for each part of your life or work**: Work, Money, Home,
  Health, School, News and fun, Writing, and Sales and clients. Press a tile for its add-ons, and an
  add-on for what it does and the button that adds it.
- **Archie Mobile is on the App Store.** The code for getting the app now opens the App Store on an
  iPhone and downloads the app on an Android phone, instead of a page about it.
- **Every personality has a face of its own**, and a personality's ears no longer get cut off in a
  reply.
- **Fixed: an email or text your agent read could approve a change it had asked you about.** Calendar
  moves already waited for a yes you typed. Now removing something from a list, deleting a to-do,
  spreadsheets, documents, your CRM, connected services and adding an add-on wait for one too.
- **Fixed: a second question in a row about your calendar or mail got the same stock answer.** It
  goes to your agent like any other message now.
- **Fixed: the welcome questions could keep going after you asked to skip them** or asked for
  something else.
- **Fixed: buttons could arrive under a failure notice.** They come with a plain question now.
- **Fixed: a message with no words in it got an error back.** Now it gets no reply.
- **Fixed: the store's tiles overlapped on a narrow window.** They keep four columns at every size.
